text.tspan: Picks a call and a situation
goal check · lines · plan advice · sprint review · evidence · report
(he may edit it, or copy it to the chat)

g.text: Is the input the shape this call takes?
The production call: same prompt, model, schema

text.tspan: Sprint review: the devlogs' images and video
are described first, as on a review day
what came back is in Raw
What the platform makes of it
report: proposed → written, each task's standing
evidence: the task delivered / on trust / not

g.text: Never in production: the page and its API answer 404
Nothing is written: no checkpoint, no usage row, no journal — the cost is only shown
One prompt: the lab calls the same builders as production, never its own copy
A devlog never closes a task alone and never turns "not about the task" into delivered
